Visitor replaces link with static custom output

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
use HtmlToMarkdown\VisitorHandle;
$visitor = new class {
    public function visit_link(...$args) {
        return ['custom' => "[REDACTED LINK]"];
    }
};
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json('{}');
$visitorHandle = \HtmlToMarkdown\VisitorHandle::from_php_object($visitor);
$options = $options->withVisitor($visitorHandle);
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<a href=\"https://example.com\">Click here</a>", $options);
var_dump($result);
```
